uncited: This family inherits the standard 3DGS representation and rendering pipeline from [Appearance and Physical Modeling](15766-appearance-and-physical-modeling.md).
The camera sensor must have a linear response to light.

The continuous attenuation model was introduced to address the geometric inconsistencies of discrete Gaussian splatting for surface extraction, leveraging theoretical results from Orienting Attenuation (OaV) [9624-continuous-attenuation-model-for-3d-gaussian-splatting.md].

Underwater 3D Gaussian Splatting (Gaussian Splashing) was developed to extend 3DGS to aquatic environments by incorporating ocean optics models, specifically addressing the limitations of vanilla 3DGS in handling distance-dependent attenuation and color casts [13980-underwater-3d-gaussian-splatting-with-backscatter-loss.md].
